meaning: The clocks that the values of four scaffold-recordings builds belong to: agricultural science (no dip and no difference between the game and the simulator after its staged start), agricultural science with backed-up belts (no difference between the game and the simulator), the inserters moved_open names for chemical science with a shared foundry, and what each row of military science with grenades moves. Each build is named as in scaffold-recordings.game.test.ts, its config by the ConfigPaths key; `clock_sha256` is the sha256 of the identity (clockIdentity) of the clock the generator selects for it. The game test refuses to run on another clock and clock-controls.test.ts checks the selection against the record, agricultural science with backed-up belts against the variants job of that build, so a clock that moves is found before those values are taken for the new clock's. The original chemical science shared-foundry values were recorded on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 on one output swing each output cycle (the previous hash, taken on 2026-10-23; no original clock recording was kept). Since targeted searches, shifted swings (Takt Batches: 2 output swings each output cycle) wins with fewer windows at equal wake-ups and recovery. Fresh Factorio 2.1.21 recording on 2026-11-01: 256 in all 103 periods, no comparison issues beyond the unchanged named exceptions; sulfur and advanced-circuit cuts plus blocked output-clock conditions each recover within the simulator's 4-period bound. The previous exact stable clock remains offered. Both agricultural science builds select batched swings (Takt Batches: 5 output swings each output cycle), one clock for both, with windows on the two inserters that take eggs out of the loop into the science biochamber and, since a later change that day, on the two inserters of the loop itself: recorded on it on 2026-10-24, 400 in every one of 74 periods from the staged start, and no difference between the game and the simulator in what any inserter or machine moved (the clock with only the first two on windows, and the same clock with all four always on, were recorded the same day with the same results, 400 in every period from the staged start and from the prepared one; the 2-swing clock before that). On 2026-11-03 (0.27.0, the one dispatch) the two agricultural science builds select different clocks, and both and the chemical science builds were recorded again under the game tests' protocol in game ticks at Factorio 2.1.24 on the clocks pinned here; the shared foundry's previous swings-1 clock is the one made today. Since #641 the enable windows of batched swings close before the hand that left an inserter asleep on its machine's list at the switch-off, which makes the shared foundry's clock before it (planned-belt-slack at 245.7 wakeups a minute) no longer made, so its pin is dropped; the clock made now (163.8 wakeups a minute) made 256 in every period on this scaffold in the game, 2026-11-06. Since #699 the per-branch clock is selected (81.9 wakeups a minute): 256 in every one of 10 periods on this scaffold in the game, 81.8 wakeups a minute in the game and the simulator, 2026-11-07; the clock before it is the previous one. Military science with grenades (five mirrored pairs) selects Coordinated Sources (2 output swings each output cycle, a window cycle of 80 ticks): recorded on it on 2026-11-10 at Factorio 2.1.24, 64 a copy (48 a second) in every one of 44 periods on each of the five copies, and 160 in every period in each of its two rows of output inserters. Since a pickup from a dead-end lane keeps the room for one more hand the selected clock is another Coordinated Sources clock of 80 ticks, with that room on the two pickups of walls and magazines into the military science assemblers: recorded on it the same day at Factorio 2.1.24, the same figures (64 a copy in every one of 44 periods on each of the five copies, 160 in every period in each row).

previous.why: the clock selected from #641 until the per-branch clock (#699), still made
